title: Efficient fixation of atmospheric CO2 as carbonate by lanthanide-based complex via synergistic effect of zinc ion

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: tetranuclear zinc(II)–europium(III) carbonato-bridged Schiff-base cluster ethanol solvate

synthesis.procedure: The mononuclear precursor [Zn(L)(H2O)] was prepared in 92% yield by a literature method. The air- and moisture-stable cluster was then obtained by reaction of EuCl3·6H2O with [Zn(L)(H2O)] in a 1:1 molar ratio in ethanol in the presence of triethylamine. Prismatic yellow crystals of [Zn4Eu4L4(CO3)6]·EtOH suitable for X-ray diffraction formed in 32% yield by slow evaporation of the solution under aerobic conditions over two weeks. The paper states that atmospheric CO2 is the source of the bridging carbonate ligands.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by slow evaporation under aerobic conditions
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Prismatic yellow crystals obtained by slow evaporation of the ethanol solution in air over two weeks.

properties.summary: No magnetic or optical (luminescence/absorption) measurements are reported for the Eu cluster; magnetic studies of Gd/Dy analogues and spectroscopic studies of Nd analogues are stated as future work.
